instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.a: Alexandra took a roll of bubble gum with a length of 1.7 m to school. First, she gave her best friend 45 cm of the roll. Then, she gave 32 cm to Jerry. To top it off, she gave Caroline another 66 cm. How much of the roll of bubble gum did Alexandra give away?
atoms.sound: Alexandra took a roll of bubble gum with a length of 1.7 metres to school. First, she gave her best friend 45 cm of the roll. Then, she gave 32 cm to Jerry. To top it off, she gave Caroline another 66 cm. How much of the roll of bubble gum did Alexandra give away?

atoms.a: How many centimetres of the roll does Alexandra have left? Convert, then solve this problem.

atoms.b: Alexandra gave away <mat><gap>143</gap></mat> cm of her roll of bubble gum and has <mat><gap>27</gap></mat> cm left.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.a: Luis has built a toy racetrack and is simulating a grand prix with his best friend. He wants the cars to travel a total of 38 metres. How far is this in centimetres?
If one lap has a length of 50 cm, what division can you do to work out how many laps they would have to finish?
Which other division can this be simplified to?

atoms.b: They would have to finish <mat><gap>76</gap></mat> laps to reach a distance of 38 metres.
